'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You know, I have foreign partners who are working on evacuating important assets from Tarkov. They are especially interested in Reserve and the laboratory beneath the city. But recently, they have encountered some competition... Can you help and eliminate these obstacles?}}

==Requirements==
* Obtain level 3 loyalty with [[Peacekeeper]]

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 10 [[Scav Raiders|Raiders]] or [[Black Division]] operatives on [[Reserve]] or [[The Lab]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 1,900 Euros
** 1,995 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 2,185 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 4× [[Power supply unit]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[7.62x51mm M80]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
{{quote|Excellent work! Now my partners will be able to operate on these locations much more easily.}}

==Guide==
[[Scav Raiders]] may sometimes be found in the command area of the underground tunnel system at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction power switch has been activated. The arrival of the train may also spawn them at the train yard. Additionally, pulling the "Bunker hermetic door" extraction lever may spawn them at the train yard.
